data.one_liner: A command-line tool that simplifies updating your Flutter app launcher icon.
data.what_it_does: Automates the generation and updating of launcher icons for Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux from a configuration file. Supports flavor configurations, adaptive icons, and platform-specific options like dark and tinted icons for iOS 18.
use_when: You want to automate setting up and updating launcher icons across multiple platforms.
You are managing multiple app flavors and need different launcher icons for each flavor.
avoid_when: You prefer manually configuring and resizing native icon assets for each platform.
You are not using a Dart/Flutter command-line workflow.
strengths: Supports a wide range of platforms including Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
Built-in support for multiple app flavors via separate configuration files.
Supports advanced icon configurations like iOS 18 dark/tinted icons and Android adaptive icons.
weaknesses: Requires managing a YAML configuration file separate from standard pubspec or native assets.
Command-line setup only, lacks an interactive UI wizard.
data.setup_notes: Add your configuration to `pubspec.yaml` or a separate `icons_launcher.yaml` file, then run `dart run icons_launcher:create`.

alternatives.name: flutter_launcher_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is another popular CLI tool for generating launcher icons in Flutter.

data.minimal_example:
icons_launcher:
  platforms:
    android:
      enable: true
      image_path: "assets/ic_logo_radius.png"
    ios:
      enable: true
      image_path: "assets/ic_logo_rectangle_light.png"
